sentences.en: On Saturday, she punished him by making him paint the fence.
The fence was long and the sun burning.

sentences.ar: مرق صاحبه بن وصار يضحك عليه.
sentences.en: His friend Ben passed and began laughing at him.

sentences.ar: توم ما رد، وضل يدهن بهدوء وتركيز.
sentences.en: Tom did not answer, and kept painting calmly and carefully.
Ben said: let me try a little.

sentences.ar: قال توم: لأ، هاي شغلة بدها مهارة.
sentences.en: Tom said: no, this is work that needs skill.

sentences.ar: بن أعطاه تفاحة عشان يتركه يدهن.
sentences.en: Ben gave him an apple so he would let him paint.

sentences.ar: وبعده إجوا ولاد تانيين ودفعوا كمان.
sentences.en: And after him other boys came and paid as well.

sentences.ar: السور خلص، وتوم صار عنده كنز صغير.
sentences.en: The fence was finished, and Tom had a small treasure.
